purpose: Source-backed study-level design structure for reproducing PPS experiments without widening the paper audit into separate pre/post, group, intervention, session, and crossover columns. Each entry binds participant assignment, PPS measurement occasions, factor scope, ordering/spacing, interventions, and protocol variants to an experiment-specific study row.
canonicalization_rules: A registry suffix identifies a formal experiment or profile variant, never a within-participant condition, arm, timepoint, or intervention phase.
The wide matrix exposes one study_structure_schedule contract. Repeating factors and ordered phases remain normalized in factors and events.
Only publication- or manual-review-backed structure is recorded. Toolkit packaging choices and template defaults are not promoted to paper evidence.

Within-trial event timing remains in trial_sequence; PPS block composition remains in block_order_contract. This file records the higher-level participant, condition, session, visit, and intervention topology and references those contracts rather than duplicating them.
Unknown sample sizes, allocation methods, order, spacing, washout, or condition-to-profile bindings remain explicitly unresolved.

completion_rules.reported_complete: Every required component is reported or not applicable, and every applicable ordering/intervention component is reported or not applicable.
completion_rules.derived_complete: The reported-complete rule is met and at least one satisfied component is derived with an explicit derivation note.
completion_rules.partial: At least one required or applicable conditional component is partial, not reported, or not assessed.
completion_rules.conflicting_evidence: At least one required or applicable conditional component contains unresolved source conflict that changes executable order or allocation.
